title: Heated Insoles With Remote Control – Warm Feet On The Stand
seo_title: Heated Insoles With Remote Control – Three Heat Modes
seo_description: Two heated insoles with remote control, three heat modes and cut lines for EU sizes 41–46. USB cable and manual included.
descriptionHtml:
The cold creeps upward before your time on the stand is even half over

You stand still hour after hour at the moose stand, and the first cold jabs in your toes come after just fifteen minutes. You know there are hours left, and that the cold will only creep further in the longer you stand still.

Three heat modes you control without moving a foot

Two insoles are trimmed to your own shoe size along the printed lines, EU sizes 41–46, and controlled with a key-fob remote. The USB cable charges the battery, 2000 mAh according to the supplier.

Features

  • Keeps your feet warm through your whole time on the stand – three modes: high, medium, low
  • Controlled with the remote, without you moving a foot – the remote has its own keyring
  • Trimmed to your own shoe size – cut lines for EU sizes 41–46 printed on the insole
  • Charges with a regular USB cable – no special charger required
  • 4–10 hours per charge according to the supplier – the time depends on which mode you choose

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
